verdict.rationale: Stripe is a payments platform and API that acts as a tool provider to agents; consuming third-party MCP servers is an agent or host role, not this product's role. The evidence shows Stripe only serving tools (its hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com, plus agent plugins installed into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor). Nothing shows Stripe itself acting as an MCP client, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
